pages.text: Two mods fill the Overworld with ordinary-feeling animals. They are vanilla-style: no bosses, no new dimension, just more to see and sometimes tame.

$(thing)Critters and Companions$() adds dragonflies (with armor), ferrets, koi, red pandas, jumping spiders, ladybugs, leaf insects, snails and more, plus a Grappling Hook and Pearl Necklaces. Its otter, Dumbo Octopus and Sea Bunny spawns are off; Hybrid Aquatic has those.

pages.title: Koi Fish
pages.text: A pond fish that can be carried in a bucket.

$(thing)Naturalist$() adds land animals: bears, deer, boar, lions, tigers, zebras, giraffes, elephants, hippos, rhinos, lizards, snakes, tortoises, ducks, turkeys, vultures and more. Nine sea animals are off: anglerfish, blobfish, giant isopod, great white shark, piranha, jellyfish, starfish, crab and ray.

pages.title: Capture Net
pages.text: Naturalist's tool to catch small creatures like butterflies and firefly.
Sea creatures: $(l:ocean/sea_life)Sea Life$(/l). Creature drops feed cooking in $(l:food/farmers_delight)Farmer's Delight$(/l).
